product.title: Lima by night including Catacombs & Water Show Tour

description.text: In Lima, this small-group evening starts at the San Francisco Monastery catacombs, continues through the historic center around Plaza de Armas, and ends at the Magic Water Circuit. Air-conditioned hotel pickup plus tickets to the catacombs and the water show are included, with a published 4:00 p.m. start from Barranco, Miraflores, San Isidro, or downtown Lima. The group is listed with a maximum of 15. Commentary stays on the monastery crypts and the illuminated colonial squares rather than a daytime museum hop. The format suits visitors who want a guided night window without buying catacomb and fountain tickets independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on San Francisco Monastery, Plaza de Armas, and the Magic Water Circuit that define this evening.

highlights: Small-group evening tour of Lima after the daytime crowds
San Francisco Monastery catacombs with included admission
Historic-center walk around Plaza de Armas
Hotel pickup from Barranco, Miraflores, San Isidro, or downtown Lima

end.description: Return to your Lima meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
